metric.name: Design drawings — complete, consistent views and conventions
metric.text: Provide a complete and consistent set of views disclosing the design; use crisp black line drawings, correct broken‑line practice, and surface shading to show 3D contours; comply with design‑specific drawing formalities and jurisdictional/Hague nuances.
